A Special seafood restaurant
May 2026 • Couples
My wife and I together with friends attended the Fatfish restaurant Danang just across the road from the Dragon Bridge.
We went there on the recommendation of our tour guide the previous day and we were very pleased we did.
It was a Sunday which coincided with the bridge Dragon breathing fire at 9pm which was a sight.
Now back to the restaurant good menu and plenty of drinks.
Mainly seafood, we had been in Vietnam for a number of weeks and two of us went for the battered Fish and chips while the other two went for the house special grilled fish.All meals were great especially with the food beer.
We can highly recommend this restaurant, not expensive.
